t.name: South Fork Skokomish River Trail 873
t.description: This trail wanders through old growth forest and crosses the South Fork Skokomish River and other streamss befoe climbing up the national park boundary.

t.name: Church Creek Trail #871
t.description: This fairly steep 3.5 mile trail follows Church Creek towards a pass through a conifer forest, eventually ending near Satsup Lakes on Forest Road #2372.

t.name: Spoon Creek Falls Trail #885
t.description: This trail is a short 0.3 mile trail that descends steeply to the creek near the base of the waterfall. The hike setting provides a small stream and waterfall in old growth and second growth conifer forests.

t.name: Petes Creek Trail #858
t.description: This difficult trail leads into beautiful temperate rain forest within Colonel Bob Wilderness. Towering conifers including Sitka spruce, Douglas-fir, western hemlock and western red cedar provide dense shade for this trail.

t.name: Colonel Bob Trail #851
t.description: This trail is located within Colonel Bob Wilderness in a setting of dense old-growth conifer forest with lush understory of rain forest vegetation. Panoramic view of Quinault Lake from summit of Colonel Bob.

t.name: Lower Pete's Creek Trail #858.1
t.description: The trail traverses a flat bench with Douglas-fir and western hemlock before dropping 400 feet to the West Fork Humptulips River. From the Pete's Creek Trailhead the river is reached in a short 1.0 mile.

t.name: West Fork Humptulips Trail #806
t.description: This trail follows the river within a remote valley. The trail fords the river multiple times and winds along the western edge of Moonlight Dome Roadless Area.
